Hi Sophie — thanks for the checklist.

Quick answers:

- EU-only processing: We can offer EU-region residency hosted in our Frankfurt and Amsterdam clusters. Logs and telemetry can be retained in-region; we support KMS keys scoped to EU regions. We'll draft redline language for the renewal SOW.
- APAC pilot: We can provision reserved burst capacity in APAC (Singapore) for Q3 pilots. There is a modest one-time onboarding charge plus usage-based billing; estimate attached.
- Cross-region failover SLA: We can include a defined RTO for failover, with an automated regional fallback policy. We'll propose 15-minute RTO for critical endpoints, with a cost/credit table for missed RTOs.

I'll loop Karthik from Solutions to prepare the technical addendum. Can we schedule a 45-min renewal call next Tue?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sophie,

Adding technical details so your procurement team can review:

- Data residency: we'll deploy a dedicated routing policy that pins production tokens to eu-west-1 nodes and ensures telemetry is written to EU Kinesis streams. We can also rotate EU KMS keys every 90 days and provide key access logs.
- Logs & audit: SOC 2 audit artifacts and audit logs can be delivered via an EU-only S3 bucket with restricted IAM roles — we'll include the delivery cadence in the SOW.
- APAC burst: For pilots we recommend a 2-week warm-up with 4 reserved GPUs and auto-burst to 12 GPUs for 3-hour windows. Estimate in attached sheet; costs are usage + $3,000 onboarding.
- Failover behavior: failover triggers are regional health + latency thresholds. During failover, traffic is routed to the nearest compatible model variant in EU fallback or APAC (configurable). RTO measurement will be based on edge convergence time; propose SLA credit tiers.

I'll prepare a short technical addendum and the config snippets for your security team.

-Karthik
Solutions Architect
